name: Mech-GlueCheck
summary: Robot-connected glue-inspection software for configuring camera acquisition, creating bead models and checking dispensing results. It monitors camera, robot and PLC connections and maintains inspection history and production data.

description.en: Robot-connected glue-inspection software for configuring camera acquisition, creating bead models and checking dispensing results. It monitors camera, robot and PLC connections and maintains inspection history and production data.

sources.quote: Mech-GlueCheck provides a method to automatically compute the DPI value;

sources.quote: Used to display the images acquired by the three cameras.

sources.title: User Manual
sources.quote: Inspection status indicators: a total of 8 types, used to indicate the glue inspection result.

sources.title: User Manual
sources.quote: The communication protocol between the robot and the software defines two types of commands: triggering image acquisition and obtaining inspection results.
